name: Affan Khamse
bio:
I turn AI prototypes into systems that hold up in production. At Centh AI, I build the agent that verifies clinicians against 50+ primary sources and cut each check from 5 minutes to under 30 seconds. Before that, I cut an AI call assistant's latency by more than half at Novum AI.
NYU MS CS 2025. Based in NYC.
